title: Before Dark
logline: A young traveler promises his dog they'll cross a gorge before dark, and a charming stranger offers a faster way, if he leaves the dog behind.
hook: The trailer's opening image: the Fool on a cliff edge under a yellow sun. "They call me the Fool. Because I believe I have infinite potential." Then a boot hits a plank and it lurches.
standalone: A cocky young man who jokes about everything is made to choose between two promises, and we glimpse, for one second, the home he ran from.
nolanDevice: Ticking clock. The sun sinks behind the ridge across the whole conversation, and every clever line costs daylight.
devilTest: The Traveler offers a rope bridge that only takes one. Leave the dog; dogs always find their way. He frames it as keeping the Fool's promise.
cost: Time. He keeps the dog and loses the daylight.

giftLearned.gift: A promise kept to someone who can't ask for it
giftLearned.gesture: Hand on the dog's head

giftsUsed.howShown: He walks back, kneels and puts his hand on the dog's head before he answers.

xv: XV scratched into the empty rock (spotlighted once, in Episode 1, to teach the audience the game).
threads: planted: the Traveler, his downward torch and chain bracelet
planted: the Fool's promise to the dog
planted: 'People who stayed', the home he left (paid off E19)

shots.title: They call me the Fool
shots.framing: The trailer's opening image: wide side view, the Fool on a cliff edge, the drop ahead of him screen-right, the white dog at his heel on safe ground, a huge yellow sun. Slow push toward his face.
shots.action: He stands at the edge, chin up, staff and bundle on his shoulder, white rose in hand. He speaks to the whole world.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: They call me the Fool. Because I believe I have infinite potential.
shots.delivery: Bright, proud, half a joke and half a creed. Visible mouth.
shots.sound: Wind, one unresolved note, a paw scuff.

shots.title: Promise
shots.framing: Extreme low angle on the plank, boot entering frame, gorge roaring below; tilt up to his grin.
shots.action: His boot lands on the last surviving plank. It lurches toward the drop. He grins at the dog like this is a game.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: We'll make it across before dark. Promise.
shots.delivery: Breezy, to the dog, like a dare he's already won.

shots.title: A test plank
shots.framing: Whip pullback as he leaps back to the rock; dog in the foreground.
shots.action: The plank tips. He leaps back and lands badly on the rock. The dog barks once. He brushes himself off with a showman's bow, too quickly.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: I'm fine. That was a test plank.
shots.sound: One sharp bark. The plank knocking below.

shots.title: The long way
shots.framing: Wide. The sun touching the ridge. Plank, uphill road and river bend all readable. Card label fades in: 0 · THE FOOL.
shots.action: He looks from the plank to the long uphill road to the sun. The grin fades a little.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: The long way round takes all day.
shots.delivery: Quiet. The first honest sentence, said to the dog.
shots.sound: A low tick enters the music. It won't stop until S14.

shots.title: Already there
shots.framing: Slow push past the Fool's shoulder to a rock that was empty a second ago.
shots.action: He turns. The Traveler is sitting on a flat rock, hood up, torch pointed at the ground, a loose chain wrapped around his wrist like jewelry. The dog backs into the Fool's boot.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: There's a faster way. A rope bridge, round the bend.
shots.delivery: Friendly, unhurried, like he's doing a favor for a neighbor.
shots.sound: The river drops out. One chain link clinks as he gestures.

shots.title: Interesting ones
shots.framing: Two-shot. The Fool recovers his swagger.
shots.action: The Fool points at him, half laughing, half spooked.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: You always sit on rocks waiting for people?
shots.delivery: Covering the fright with a joke.

shots.title: Only the interesting ones
shots.framing: Tight on the Traveler, lit from below by his own torch.
shots.action: He tilts his head, enjoying himself.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Only the interesting ones. The Fool. Infinite potential, wasn't it?
shots.delivery: Amused. He was listening the whole time.

shots.title: You've heard of me
shots.framing: The Fool, unsettled for a second, then preening.
shots.action: He straightens, flattered and a little spooked.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: Who calls you that?
shots.framing: Hold on the Fool as the question lands. His grin stays one beat too long, then slips.
shots.action: The Traveler asks it softly. The Fool's smile slips. He looks at the gorge, not at the man.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.sound: The music stops. Only the river.

shots.title: People who stayed
shots.framing: Close on the Fool. The first crack in the act.
shots.action: He shrugs, too lightly.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Flat. He didn't mean to say it.
shots.sound: Wind. One heartbeat of silence after the line.

shots.title: Dogs don't fit
shots.framing: The Traveler stands for the first time; his eyes go to the dog.
shots.action: He rises and brushes off his cloak. He nods down at the dog without looking at it directly.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Then you'll love my bridge. It takes one. Dogs don't fit.
shots.delivery: Regretful. A shrug in the voice.

shots.title: Mostly fur
shots.framing: The Fool scoops a hand toward the dog, pleading like a salesman.
shots.action: He gestures at the dog as if presenting evidence in court.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: They always do
shots.framing: Over the Traveler's shoulder onto the Fool; the sun half gone behind them.
shots.action: The Traveler steps closer, warm and reasonable. The Fool looks at the bend, then the sun.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Leave him. Dogs find their way. You'll be across before dark, like you promised. That's keeping your word.
shots.delivery: Warm, patient, almost kind. He turns the Fool's promise into the bait.
shots.sound: Ticking under the music. A chain link on 'word'.

shots.title: One step
shots.framing: Wide. The Fool takes a step toward the bend. The dog does not follow. It sits in the last of the light.
shots.action: He walks three steps toward the rope bridge, talking himself into it. The dog stays where it is.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: He'd find me. Right? They always do.
shots.delivery: Half to himself. Trying the Traveler's words on.
shots.sound: The tick becomes a pulse. Then the pulse stops.

shots.title: I said we
shots.framing: Low angle on the Fool's face as he turns back; then down to the dog as he kneels and puts his hand on its head.
shots.action: He looks back at the dog sitting alone. He walks back and kneels, his hand on the dog's head.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: I didn't say 'I'll make it across.' I said 'we'll'.
shots.delivery: Quiet. Not to the Traveler. To the dog, and to himself.
shots.sound: Music drops to one held note.

shots.title: Which promise?
shots.framing: Tight on the Traveler, who hasn't moved. He's delighted, as if the Fool had solved a riddle the wrong way.
shots.action: He smiles and lets the question hang.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: You also said 'before dark'. So which one was the lie?
shots.delivery: Soft. Precise. He lets it sting.

shots.title: Then I'll be late
shots.framing: Wide as the Fool stands and turns to the uphill road. The sun vanishes behind the ridge on his last word.
shots.action: He stands, shoulders the bundle, and lifts the white rose to the Traveler like a salute. Then he starts up the long road. The dog trots after him. The sun is gone.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Light again, grinning. Chosen, not cornered. A salute with the rose.
shots.sound: The ticking stops dead. A warm phrase of music.

shots.title: Late is how it starts
shots.framing: Hold on the Traveler in the blue dark, his torch the only warm light.
shots.action: He watches them climb. His torch flares once, pointing down.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Late is how it starts. Then... just one yes.
shots.sound: Chain link. A low drone rises.

shots.title: Late. But together.
shots.framing: On the uphill road, the Fool looks back; reverse to the empty rock; then the river.
shots.action: He glances back. The rock is empty. Scratched into it: XV. The dog growls at it. The Fool ruffles its ears and keeps climbing. Below, the plank breaks free and slides downstream, the same plank from the first frame.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Tired, warm, to the dog. He means it.
shots.sound: A growl. Wind. The plank knocking away downstream.

title: The Weight
logline: Freezing on a night climb with a limping dog, a traveler is offered help carrying everything he owns. The price is a flower he swears means nothing.
hook: His bundle bounces down an icy scree slope in the dark and he slides after it.
standalone: A man claims he doesn't care about a flower, can't give it up, and carries his dog up a frozen mountain instead.
nolanDevice: Cold open in the middle of the action, then a reframe: the thing he calls worthless is the thing he protects.
devilTest: The Traveler will carry the bundle to the top. The price: the white rose. "It's just a flower" makes it an easy yes.
cost: Comfort. He climbs the hardest way, carrying the dog and the bundle together.

giftLearned.gesture: Tucking the rose inside his tunic

giftsUsed.howShown: His hand goes to the dog's head, the same gesture as Episode 1, before he lifts it.

xv: At dawn, the snapped bridge pilings below stand in a pattern that reads as X and V.
threads: paid off: the promise to the dog
planted: the broken bridge over the gorge
planted: 'It's just a flower' (the Fool's first lie to himself)
planted: the rose over his heart (paid off E20)

shots.title: Everything I own
shots.framing: Handheld-feel tumble following the bundle down the scree, the Fool sliding into frame after it.
shots.action: The bundle bounces down the icy scree. He slides after it on his back, flailing, and the dog skids behind him.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.sound: Scree hiss, a bundle thump, frantic paws.

shots.title: Heavy, for a man who owns nothing
shots.framing: The bundle stops against a boot. Tilt up the dark cloak to the torch and hood.
shots.action: The Traveler is already there, sitting on a boulder, the bundle resting against his foot. He weighs it in one hand.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Heavy, for a man who owns nothing.
shots.sound: Wind. The chain clinks as he lifts it.

shots.title: Mostly bread
shots.framing: Two-shot on the slope; the Fool out of breath, frost on his cap.
shots.action: The Fool reaches for it. The Traveler lets him take it, then nods at the white rose in his other hand.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: The price
shots.framing: Tight on the rose, then the Traveler's eyes under the hood.
shots.action: The Traveler points the torch at the rose without touching it.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: I'll carry it to the top. You give me that.

shots.title: It's just a flower
shots.framing: The Fool looks at the rose, laughs, and holds it out.
shots.action: He shrugs and extends the rose. His fingers don't open.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Too casual. He believes it for one second.
shots.sound: Music thins to a high note.

shots.title: The dog is limping
shots.framing: The dog whines. Cut low to its paw lifting off the ice.
shots.action: The dog holds up a frozen paw and shivers. The Fool looks down. His hand goes to the dog's head, the Episode 1 gesture.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: Not today
shots.framing: He tucks the rose inside his tunic and lifts the dog into his arms.
shots.action: He tucks the rose inside his tunic over his heart, lashes the staff and bundle across his back, and scoops the dog up in both arms.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Warm and certain. No joke this time.

shots.title: You can't carry both
shots.framing: The Traveler, amused, rises for the first time.
shots.action: The Traveler stands and brushes snow off his cloak.
shots.speaker: traveler

shots.title: Watch me
shots.framing: Long climbing shot up the switchbacks, the Fool small against the mountain, dog in arms, bundle bouncing on the staff.
shots.action: He climbs, slips, climbs. The Traveler strolls alongside effortlessly, never out of breath. Frost thickens on the Fool's brows. The sky begins to pale.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.sound: Boots crunching, breath, a slowly rising theme.

shots.title: The top
shots.framing: The Fool crests the ridge into the first sunlight and collapses laughing, the dog licking his face.
shots.action: He sets the dog down, falls on his back in the snow, laughing. The Traveler is gone.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: Laughter, a bark, the theme resolving.

shots.title: Someone should fix that
shots.framing: Push over his shoulder down into the valley: the gorge far below, and the snapped pilings of an old bridge.
shots.action: He sits up and sees, far below, the gorge he couldn't cross and the black stumps of a bridge someone once built. The pilings stand in a shape like X and V.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: A throwaway. He has no idea.

title: Something That Holds
logline: A drifter who says he can do anything is asked by a master craftsman to prove it, just as the roof beam above them starts to split.
hook: A roof beam cracks over the Magician's head and dust pours down. The Fool drops his bundle and catches it.
standalone: A cocky young man learns the difference between holding something up and fixing it, and is offered the chance to make something of his own.
nolanDevice: Silence before impact. Every creak of the beam is followed by a beat of total silence before it gives a little more.
devilTest: The Traveler, leaning in the doorway: learning a trade is a cage. Walk away and stay free.
cost: Pride. He can only hold the beam; the Magician is the one who saves the room.

giftLearned.gift: Use what is on the table
giftLearned.gesture: One hand up, one hand down, then eyes to the materials

xv: Hidden: among the Magician's tools in S04, a pentacle lies upside down, scratched XV. It is never pointed at.
threads: paid off: trailer line 'You can. But if you're infinite, can you choose and create something?'

shots.title: Crack
shots.framing: Low angle up at the beam as it splits; the Magician beneath it; the Fool in the doorway.
shots.action: The beam cracks and sags. Dust pours onto the Magician's table. The Fool drops his bundle, runs in and jams his staff under the beam, straining to hold it.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: Hold that
shots.framing: The Magician doesn't flinch. Two-shot: Magician left, Fool right, as in the trailer.
shots.action: The Magician looks at the Fool straining under the beam as if assessing a tool.
shots.speaker: magician

shots.title: The doorway
shots.framing: Rack focus to the doorway behind them.
shots.action: The Traveler leans in the doorway, arms folded, torch pointed down, watching like it's a show.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Careful. Learn one thing, you become one thing.

shots.title: One hand up
shots.framing: The Magician raises his wand hand and points the other at his table. His eyes go to the materials.
shots.action: One hand up, one hand down, then his eyes move across the table: a cup, a sword, a wand, a pentacle, scraps of wood.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: A soft chime on each object.

shots.title: Scraps
shots.framing: Quick precise cutaways: the Magician's hands.
shots.action: He takes a scrap of oak, splits it with the sword, hammers the wedge into the crack with the wand's butt. Three strokes. The groaning stops.
shots.speaker: magician
shots.delivery: Working, muttering to the wood. Not teaching.

shots.title: Let go
shots.framing: The Magician taps the Fool's shoulder; he slowly lets go. The beam holds.
shots.action: The Fool eases out from under the beam, braced for it to fall. It holds. He looks at his own empty hands.
shots.speaker: magician
shots.dialogue: You held it. I fixed it. Different jobs.
shots.sound: A long exhale from the Fool.

shots.title: I could've
shots.framing: The Fool dusts off, recovering his swagger.
shots.action: He picks up his bundle with a flourish.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: I could've done that. I can do anything.

shots.title: The question
shots.framing: Push in on the Magician. The trailer's line, in the trailer's framing: Magician left, Fool right, table between.
shots.action: The Magician raises his wand, lowers his other hand to the table, and meets the Fool's eyes.
shots.speaker: magician
shots.dialogue: You can. But if you're infinite, can you choose and create something?
shots.delivery: Measured. Not a lecture. A dare.
shots.sound: Wood tap, then space for the question.

shots.title: Tomorrow
shots.framing: The Magician slides a rough block of wood across the table.
shots.action: He sets a block of wood in front of the Fool.
shots.speaker: magician
shots.delivery: Casual. It matters more than he lets on.

shots.title: Maybe
shots.framing: The Fool looks at the block, then at the door where the Traveler waits.
shots.action: He glances between the wood and the doorway. He smiles his easy smile.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Charming. Evasive. The word he hides behind.
shots.sound: Music pauses on an unresolved note.

shots.title: A beautiful word
shots.framing: Outside. The Traveler falls in step beside him.
shots.action: They walk out into the sunlight together. The Traveler throws an arm around his shoulders like an old friend.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Maybe never ends. That's the beauty of it.

devilTest: A flawless peg taken from the Magician's own shelf appears on the bench. "Nobody checks pegs."
cost: Public pride. He has to choose in plain view of the man he most wants to impress.

shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: It's yours if you say so

title: What the Silence Knows
logline: Dared to race a stranger across a dry stone causeway, a young man is stopped mid-stride by a silent woman who can hear what's under the stones.

standalone: A man learns to stop and listen before he steps, and the one who wouldn't listen falls through.
nolanDevice: Silence before impact. When the Priestess lifts one finger, the whole soundtrack drops to silence, and in the silence we hear the water.
devilTest: "Across before the moon rises. Race you." Speed over understanding.
cost: Safety. A slab gives way under his front foot.

giftLearned.gesture: Palm flat on the stone, ear close to it

giftsUsed.gift: Use what is on the table
giftsUsed.howShown: He takes the offcut from his bundle and taps each slab: solid knock or hollow note.

shots.speaker: fool

shots.speaker: none

shots.title: Inches
shots.framing: The lion skids to a stop an arm's length away, roaring into his face.
shots.action: The Fool's open hand lowers slowly. A flash of Strength's lemniscate.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: The breath
shots.framing: Close: the lion's breath stirring the feather on his cap. His hand, open, not touching.
shots.action: The lion sniffs his hand. It trembles. It lies down.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: Purr, low. The music returns, very quiet.

shots.title: You could've run
shots.framing: The Traveler, arriving, torch still lit.
shots.action: He looks at the Fool with open curiosity.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: You could have turned him with a word.

shots.title: So was I
shots.framing: The Fool, not taking his eyes off the lion.
shots.action: He keeps his open hand lowered over the lion's head.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: He was scared. So was I.

shots.title: I light the way
shots.framing: The Traveler lifts the torch, pointing down, and smiles.
shots.action: The Traveler turns the torch in his hand, flame pointing at the grass.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.delivery: Charming, but his smile is thinner.

shots.title: The flower
shots.framing: Strength has come. She takes a flower from her garland and tucks it in the Fool's cap.
shots.action: Strength takes a flower from her garland and, without a word, tucks it into his cap.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: Looser

shots.action: He looks at it. He doesn't touch it.

title: A Quieter Loneliness
logline: Freezing on a mountaintop with an old man who won't speak, a traveler finally admits who he misses, and the lantern shows him who has been walking beside him all along.
hook: "Stay awake. Stay awake." A man in a blizzard, the dog licking his face, staggering toward one light.
standalone: A lonely man says out loud what he wants, and a light shows him the shadow of the friend who was never a friend.
nolanDevice: Reframe reveal. The lantern, lifted to look outward, throws the Traveler's true shadow on the rock.
devilTest: "Company. Warmth. Every road at once. Just one yes." Loneliness as a doorway.
cost: Surviving the night. Refusing the torch means freezing.

giftLearned.gesture: Lifting the light to look, not to lead

giftsUsed.howShown: He names, out loud and one by one, the people and places he misses.

xv: Spotlight: the Traveler's shadow on the rock is the Devil card itself.

shots.title: The lantern
shots.framing: A blizzard on a mountain peak at night. One lantern light ahead.
shots.action: A blizzard. He staggers toward a single lantern light on the peak, the dog in his arms licking his face to keep him awake.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: The Hermit
shots.framing: The Hermit, grey-cloaked, bearded, holding the lantern with its six-pointed star, says nothing.
shots.action: He turns and walks to a small fire in the lee of a rock. The Fool follows.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: Wind drops as they reach shelter.

shots.title: Chatter
shots.framing: By the fire. The Fool fills the silence, performing.
shots.action: The Hermit says nothing. The Fool's jokes die in the cold.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: Nice place. Great views. Terrible neighbors, I bet. No neighbors, you say?

shots.title: Silence
shots.framing: The Hermit, in silence, just looks at him. Long hold.
shots.action: The Fool stops talking. The quiet is enormous.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: One yes
shots.framing: The Traveler, on the other side of the fire, warming his hands, already there.
shots.action: The Hermit's fire is dying. On the other side of it, warming his hands, the Traveler holds out his burning torch.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.dialogue: Warmth. Company. Every road at once. Just one yes.
shots.delivery: The warmest he has ever sounded.

shots.title: I miss them
shots.framing: The Fool, looking into the fire.
shots.action: He says it before he can joke.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: No, thanks
shots.framing: The Fool, shivering, shakes his head at the torch.
shots.action: He refuses. The fire gutters. The Hermit, silent, takes a stub of wick from his cloak, lights it from his own lantern, and puts it in the Fool's hands.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: The fire hisses low. A tiny flame catches.

shots.title: Who?
shots.framing: The Hermit speaks, one word.
shots.action: The Hermit doesn't look up from the fire.
shots.speaker: hermit

shots.title: Out loud
shots.framing: The Fool, eyes up, naming them one by one. Each name gets a tiny flash of that card's symbol.
shots.action: He counts them off on his fingers.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: The Magician. The Empress. Her stupid little plant. A broken bridge I don't even own.

shots.title: Lift
shots.framing: The Hermit stands and lifts his lantern high, to look outward, not to lead.
shots.action: The Fool copies him without thinking, rising, his eyes following the light.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: What the light shows
shots.framing: The lantern light carries impossibly far over the valley: tiny, glowing, the workshop, the garden, the gorge and the snapped pilings.
shots.action: Everything he named, far away but real.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: The shadow
shots.framing: The lantern also throws the Traveler's shadow against the rock wall behind them.
shots.action: The shadow has horns. Wings. A raised hand. A torch pointed down.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: Who are you?
shots.framing: The Fool turns slowly from the shadow to the man.
shots.action: The Traveler hasn't moved. He's smiling.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: Very quiet. All the fear arrives at once.

shots.title: Never ask
shots.framing: The Traveler, delighted.
shots.action: Cut to black on his smile.
shots.speaker: traveler
shots.delivery: Warm. Terrifying. His own offer, turned inside out.

title: The Lamp and the Chain
logline: The Devil drops his disguise on a frozen peak and offers a man the road home in exchange for one yes. Refusing means losing the bet, and maybe the way back.
hook: The Traveler's cloak falls. Bat wings unfold. Two chained figures appear behind him on a pedestal.
standalone: Offered safety for his freedom, a man uses everything he has learned to refuse, keeps his word even to the Devil, and decides to build his own way home.
nolanDevice: The final trap. The only way to win the bet is to say yes, and saying yes is the loss. Every earlier gift is used once, in an order the audience can count.
devilTest: "Say yes and the road opens. You'll be home before it flowers." Winning the bet means losing.
cost: His freedom and the way home.

shots.title: True form
shots.framing: The Traveler stands. His cloak falls. Bat wings unfold, horns rise, an inverted pentagram above his brow. Behind him, on a pedestal, two chained figures.
shots.action: The trailer's Devil tableau, on the peak, in the storm.
shots.speaker: devil
shots.dialogue: Not every chain feels like a prison.
shots.delivery: A gentle correction, like a teacher.
shots.sound: A single enormous chain clink. Thunder.

shots.title: Landslide
shots.framing: Across the valley, the road home. Rocks begin to slide over it.
shots.action: Across the valley, a landslide rolls over the only road down. The storm did it. He just watched.
shots.speaker: devil
shots.dialogue: You promised a flower. I bet you'd be late.
shots.delivery: Almost sympathetic. A reminder of the terms.

shots.title: The offer
shots.framing: The Devil lowers his raised hand toward the Fool.
shots.action: He speaks warmly. It is the best deal anyone has ever offered him.
shots.speaker: devil
shots.dialogue: Say yes, and the road opens. You'll be home before it flowers. You win the bet.

shots.title: 1 · His own light
shots.framing: He takes the Hermit's lantern and lifts it to look, not to lead.
shots.action: He lifts his own wick, the Hermit's gift, to look, not to lead. The light falls on the two chained figures. Their chains hang slack. No lock. On-screen counter: 1.
shots.speaker: none

shots.title: 2, 3 · Listen. Test.
shots.framing: Palm raised, head tilted: he listens. Then he leans his full weight against his own wrist chain.
shots.action: No click. No lock. The link gives. Counters 2, 3.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: Silence. Then a soft slide of metal.

shots.title: 4 · Open hand
shots.framing: He doesn't pull. With an open hand, calmly, he lifts the chain link off his wrist.
shots.action: He doesn't pull. With an open hand, calmly, he lifts the chain link off his wrist. It comes off as easily as a ring. Counter 4.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: One clear chime. The tick stops.

shots.title: 5 · No
shots.framing: He drops the chain in the snow at the Devil's hooves.
shots.action: Eyes up. Counter 5.
shots.speaker: fool

shots.title: 6 · One aim
shots.framing: The storm breaks over the peak. The Wheel of Fortune turns in the sky above, as in the trailer. The Fool holds the Charioteer's star at arm's length as his one point.
shots.action: Wind tears at him. He doesn't move. Counter 6.
shots.speaker: none
shots.sound: The storm at full force. The Wheel's deep rotation.

shots.title: 7, 8 · Know why. Tend.
shots.framing: He goes to the chained figures and shows them the loop: no lock. He doesn't lift it for them. He offers his open hand.
shots.action: He shows the chained figures the loop: no lock. He loosens it with two fingers, the Empress's way, and offers an open hand. They lift their own chains off. Counters 7, 8.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: It's a loop. Not a lock.
shots.sound: Two soft clinks of chains falling.

shots.title: You'll lose the bet
shots.framing: The Devil, not angry. Interested.
shots.action: The Devil holds out his palm for payment.
shots.speaker: devil
shots.dialogue: Late means you owe me one yes.
shots.delivery: Soft. Exact. The bet, called in.

shots.title: 9 · Keep your word
shots.framing: Hand on the dog's head, the very first gesture. Counter 9.
shots.action: He kneels, hand on the dog's head, then stands and drops the chain link into the Devil's open palm. Counter 9. He keeps even this promise.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.delivery: A smile. His word, given freely.

shots.title: 10, 11 · What's on the table
shots.framing: He kneels in the snow. Offcut, measuring cord, lantern light: the Magician's gesture, one hand up, one hand down.
shots.action: He kneels in the snow. The Magician's gesture. With the offcut he draws two banks and a span between them; lays the measuring cord across it; ties the garland flower to the cord; and tucks the rose back over his heart. Counters 10, 11.
shots.speaker: fool
shots.dialogue: Then I'll build my own way back.
shots.delivery: Low. A decision, not a boast.

shots.title: See you at the bridge
shots.framing: The Devil laughs, fading into the snow, wings folding into cloak into nothing.
shots.action: The Devil closes his hand around the link and laughs, fading into the snow, wings folding into cloak into nothing. On the empty pedestal: XV. The Wheel finishes its turn.
shots.speaker: devil
